title: IT Hardware Engineer ( Deployment and QA)
CCTV Installation Engineer
description:
CCTV Installation Engineer

Department: IT / Technical Support

Location: \[Insert Location]

Experience Required: \[Insert years, e.g. 2–4 years]

Employment Type: \[Full\-time / Contract]

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced CCTV Installation Engineer to handle end\-to\-end installation,

configuration, and maintenance of CCTV systems, with strong hands\-on expertise in structured

cabling, rack dressing, and patch management. The ideal candidate will ensure clean, organized,

and reliable network infrastructure supporting surveillance systems.

Key Responsibilities

\* Install, configure, and commission CCTV cameras, DVRs/NVRs, and related surveillance

equipment

\* Plan and execute structured cabling for CCTV and network systems (Cat5e/Cat6, fiber as

required)

\* Perform rack dressing — neatly arrange, bundle, and label cables within server/network

racks for clean and organized installations

\* Carry out patch management — terminate, test, and organize patch panels and patch cords;

maintain correct port mapping and labeling

\* Configure IP cameras, NVRs, and integrate them with the existing network infrastructure

\* Set up VLANs, switches, and basic network configurations to support CCTV traffic

\* Test cable runs and patch connections for continuity and performance before handover

\* Troubleshoot and resolve CCTV, cabling, and network connectivity issues

\* Conduct routine maintenance, inspections, and preventive checks on installed systems

\* Maintain accurate documentation — rack layouts, cable schedules, port mapping sheets,

and as\-built diagrams

\* Coordinate with clients/site teams for installation scheduling and project timelines

\* Ensure all installations comply with safety standards and cabling best practices

Requirements

\* Proven experience in CCTV installation, configuration, and commissioning

\* Hands\-on expertise in structured cabling, rack dressing, and patch panel management

\* Working knowledge of patch cord termination, cable testing tools (cable tester, crimping

tools), and labeling standards

\* Basic understanding of networking concepts — IP addressing, switches, routers, VLANs

\* Familiarity with different types of CCTV systems (analog, IP\-based) and DVR/NVR

configuration

\* Ability to read and create rack layout diagrams and cable schedules

\* Ability to work independently, manage on\-site installations, and meet project deadlines

\* Good communication, documentation, and problem\-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications

\* Diploma/Certificate in Electronics, IT, or a related field

\* Certification in structured cabling or networking (CCNA or similar) is a plus

\* Prior experience working on large\-scale CCTV or data center cabling projects

Key Skills

CCTV Installation \| Network Patching \| Rack Dressing \| Patch Management \| Structured Cabling \| IP

Camera Configuration \| Troubleshooting

Pay: From ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Support Engineer , 0-1 yrs exp , Kochi
description:
**Technical Support Engineer , 0\-1 yrs exp , Kochi**

Job Title: Junior Support EngineerExperience : 0–1 Year  
Job Type : Full\-Time Night ShiftWorking Hours: 9:00 pm to 6:00 am, Monday–Friday (Night Shift)

Role Overview :

We are looking for a Junior Support Engineer to provide production support during the night shift. The candidate will monitor applications and servers, troubleshoot basic technical issues, support application deployments, and communicate with US\-based clients and internal teams.

The candidate should have a good understanding of Linux and Windows Server, basic knowledge of Java and .NET applications, and good English communication skills.  
Key Responsibilities :

\* Monitor production applications and servers.  
\* Provide basic production\-level support and troubleshoot technical issues.  
\* Deploy and support .NET applications on IIS.  
\* Monitor IIS websites, application pools, services, and server resources.  
\* Perform basic Linux server administration and troubleshooting.  
\* Perform basic Windows Server administration and troubleshooting.  
\* Check application and server logs to identify issues.  
\* Monitor server CPU, memory, disk space, and services.  
\* Troubleshoot basic network and connectivity issues.  
\* Provide basic support for Java applications, including checking services and logs.  
\* Monitor scheduled jobs and application services.  
\* Respond to production alerts and support tickets.  
\* Escalate complex issues to the appropriate development or infrastructure team.  
\* Maintain proper incident and troubleshooting documentation.  
\* Prepare shift handover updates for the next support team.  
\* Follow production support procedures and SLA requirements.

Required Technical Skills :

\* Linux: Good basic knowledge of Linux commands, services, logs, files, permissions, and troubleshooting.  
\* Windows Server: Basic knowledge of Windows Server, IIS, Windows Services, Event Viewer, and server troubleshooting.  
\* .NET: Basic understanding of .NET applications and deployment using IIS.  
\* Java: Basic understanding of Java applications and ability to check application logs/services.  
\* Networking: Basic knowledge of IP, DNS, ports, and connectivity troubleshooting.  
\* SQL: Basic knowledge of SQL and database connectivity is an advantage.  
\* Basic knowledge of PowerShell or Bash scripting is an advantage.

English Communication \& Client Interaction :

\* Good verbal and written English communication skills are required.  
\* Ability to communicate professionally with US\-based clients.  
\* Comfortable joining client/support calls.  
\* Ability to clearly explain technical issues and provide status updates.  
\* Good communication skills for email, chat, and support tickets.

Candidate Requirements :

\* 0–1 year of experience in IT Support, Application Support, Infrastructure Support, or a related field.  
\* Freshers with relevant technical knowledge and good communication skills can also apply.  
\* Willingness to work night shifts.  
\* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.  
\* Ability to learn new technologies quickly.  
\* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.  
\* Good attention to detail and willingness to take ownership of issues.

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resume to lidiya@affable.in or contact 9539450003

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

title: FIBER TECHNICIAN
description:

Coordinate with Network Engineers and senior technicians when required.

4–8 years of relevant hands \- on experience in fiber, broadband or telecom networks.

Strong practical knowledge of fiber installation, troubleshooting and maintenance.

Ability to independently identify and resolve field\-level fiber faults.

Experience with FTTH and broadband networks preferred.
